fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_IDLE
fsm_states_transmitter.description: SOUT HIGH; THR + TX FIFO empty; THRE=1, TEMT=1.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_START_BIT
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Drive SOUT LOW for 1 bit-time (start bit).

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_DATA_BITS
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Shift out 5-8 data bits LSB-first on SOUT, one bit per BAUDOUT/16 cycle.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_PARITY_BIT
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Drive parity bit (even / odd / mark / space) if PEN=1.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_STOP_BITS
fsm_states_transmitter.description: Drive SOUT HIGH for 1, 1.5, or 2 stop bit-times.

fsm_states_transmitter.name: TX_BREAK
fsm_states_transmitter.description: While LCR.BREAK=1: hold SOUT LOW continuously.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_START_BIT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Re-sample SIN mid-bit (8 clocks into the bit cell) to confirm valid start; false start-bit detection.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_DATA_BITS
fsm_states_receiver.description: Sample SIN mid-bit (every 16th BAUDOUT) and shift into receive shift register LSB-first.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_PARITY_BIT
fsm_states_receiver.description: Sample parity bit (if PEN=1) and compare to expected parity.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_STOP_BITS
fsm_states_receiver.description: Sample stop bit(s); if 0 then FE=1.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_TRANSFER
fsm_states_receiver.description: Move received character + error bits into RBR (char mode) or RX FIFO (FIFO mode); set DR=1.

fsm_states_receiver.name: RX_BREAK_DET
fsm_states_receiver.description: SIN held LOW for ≥ entire character time → BI=1.

fsm_hints.trigger: The Master is always the initiator: it issues the wake-up request and every M-sequence; the Device only answers.
fsm_hints.rule: The Device powers up in SIO mode and enters SDCI mode only after the Master's wake-up request; the MasterCommand drives STARTUP -> PREOPERATE -> OPERATE.
fsm_hints.decode: Each M-sequence = Master message (MC + data + CKT) + Device response (data + status + CKS).

anti_deadlock_rule: TX SOUT and RX SIN are independent serial wires; full-duplex operation has no cross-coupling. The chip-select bus interface uses simple RD/WR strobes.
exit_from_reset: After Master Reset (MR=1 for ≥ 1 µs): all registers (except RBR/THR/DLL/DLM) cleared; SOUT, INTR, OUT1, OUT2, RTS, DTR set per Table I. Software must program DLL/DLM (baud) and LCR (framing) before transmission begins.

default_ready_state_recommendation.idle: In SIO mode the C/Q line carries the binary switching value; in SDCI mode the line idles at the UART idle level between characters.
default_ready_state_recommendation.resync: On a checksum/parity error the Master retries; on repeated failure it falls back to SIO and may re-wake the Device.

behavior: Transmitter SOUT is set to HIGH-Z and internally connected to receiver SIN.
Modem inputs CTS, DSR, DCD, RI are disconnected from pins; driven instead by MCR bits 0-3 (DTR→DSR, RTS→CTS, OUT1→RI, OUT2→DCD).
Allows software self-test without external loopback.

false_start_bit_detection: On SIN HIGH→LOW edge, receiver waits 8 BAUDOUT clocks (half a bit time) and re-samples; if SIN is still LOW, accept as start bit. Otherwise discard as noise.
interrupt_priority_order: 2: Received Data Available (or FIFO trigger level reached)

fsm_states_master.name: WAKE_UP
fsm_states_master.description: Issue the wake-up request on the C/Q line and detect the Device's COM rate.

fsm_states_master.name: STARTUP
fsm_states_master.description: Read the Direct Parameter page (VendorID, DeviceID, MinCycleTime, Process Data lengths, M-sequence type) and check the Device identity.

fsm_states_master.name: PREOPERATE
fsm_states_master.description: Parameterize the Device via the ISDU before cyclic data exchange.

fsm_states_master.name: OPERATE
fsm_states_master.description: Exchange cyclic Process Data each cycle; interleave On-request Data and Events.

fsm_states_master.name: FALLBACK
fsm_states_master.description: Issue Fallback (or on lost communication) and return the C/Q line to SIO mode.

fsm_states_device.name: SIO
fsm_states_device.description: Standard IO: the C/Q line is a binary switching signal; wait for a wake-up request.

fsm_states_device.name: STARTUP
fsm_states_device.description: After wake-up, present the Direct Parameter page to the Master.

fsm_states_device.name: PREOPERATE
fsm_states_device.description: Accept ISDU parameter reads/writes from the Master.

fsm_states_device.name: OPERATE
fsm_states_device.description: Exchange cyclic Process Data; serve On-request Data; raise Events.

exit_from_reset_or_poweron: On power-up the Device is in SIO mode (the C/Q line is a binary switching signal). It remains in SIO until an IO-Link Master issues a wake-up request, which switches it into SDCI communication mode.

configurations.name: SIO operation
configurations.description: C/Q line as a plain digital switching signal (no communication).

configurations.name: SDCI operation
configurations.description: UART communication on the C/Q line: cyclic Process Data + acyclic On-request Data + Events.

configurations.name: Data Storage
configurations.description: Optional Master-side parameter backup/restore so a replaced Device is auto-parameterized.

timing_dependency_rule: Cyclic Process Data exchange in OPERATE must respect the Device's MinCycleTime; the Master uses a MasterCycleTime greater than or equal to the Device's minimum. Communication cannot start until the wake-up request has switched the Device from SIO into SDCI mode.
